personal.intro: I'm a Senior Software Engineer obsessed with building scalable, responsive web applications that don't break at 2 AM. With deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and full-stack development using C#, Python, and .NET Core, I turn complex problems into elegant solutions. By day, I architect robust applications and mentor teams; by night, I am either at the gym or reading tech books. I care about clean architecture, performance, and building software that remains maintainable under real production pressure.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description: Architecting and owning production-grade serverless data ingestion platforms and event-driven processing systems for healthcare applications, focusing on scalability and reliability.
responsibilities: Architected and owned a production-grade serverless data ingestion platform on AWS using Python, processing more than 10K health events per day with 99.9% pipeline uptime.
Designed an event-driven processing pipeline using RabbitMQ and background workers to handle large clinical data files and eliminate API timeouts.
Implemented extensible device handlers in C# and .NET, enabling onboarding of multiple medical data sources for downstream analytics.
Integrated LLM-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices to accelerate delivery and reduce boilerplate authoring time.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer II
experience.description: Engineered reusable Angular component libraries and led infrastructure migrations while optimizing CI/CD pipelines for improved developer productivity and system performance.
responsibilities: Engineered a reusable Angular reactive form component library with real-time validation and dynamic field rendering.
Led migration of file storage from network paths to AWS S3, reducing retrieval latency and operational cost.
Optimized GitLab CI/CD pipelines by restructuring stages and implementing dependency caching strategies.
Improved API throughput using async programming, multithreading, and SQL query optimization.
Expanded automated test coverage to reduce production defects and improve release confidence.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Designed event-driven notification systems and automated reporting workflows while building UI components for underwriting processes.
responsibilities: Designed an event-driven notification system using the transactional outbox pattern with .NET background services.
Built automated scheduled reporting generation using C# and Hangfire to reduce manual workload.
Integrated compliance webhooks into the underwriting platform to reduce manual review effort.
Implemented Angular workflow screens with dynamic behavior and real-time validation.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description: Built warehouse management features with barcode integration and automated invoice generation while developing APIs for mobile synchronization.
responsibilities: Integrated barcode scanning into a warehouse management system to reduce picking errors.
Automated PDF invoice generation using C# and Aspose.PDF for high-volume daily processing.
Built REST APIs using .NET Framework and MySQL to synchronize inventory and order data with Android applications.
